data.title: A Message at Two
data.excerpt: At exactly two in the morning, his phone rang. The message contained only three words: "I am home."
content: The phone rang at exactly two in the morning.
No one ever called Daniel that late.
He reached for the phone and saw a message from a number he had deleted years ago.
The number belonged to his older brother, who had disappeared twelve years earlier.
He stared at the message until the screen went dark.
Daniel remembered the small brass key hanging beside the front door.
He had kept it for twelve years without knowing why.
He walked downstairs and took it from the hook.
Outside, the street was completely empty.
At the end of the road stood the old house where the two brothers had grown up.
A light was on in the upstairs bedroom.
